card.name: Word just before a noun in aspirin warnings
card.fires_on: The word "low" right before "dose aspirin" in NSAID labels, plus a few other modifiers like "same", "other" or "melted" that sit just ahead of a noun. It also fires on the start of odd names such as "chuan wu".

modes.label: Low before dose aspirin
modes.description: The word "low" in "not a substitute for low dose aspirin" or "low-dose aspirin".
modes.example: Celecoxib is not a substitute for<< low>> dose aspirin for cardiovascular protection.

modes.label: Other modifiers before a noun
modes.description: Words like "other" or "same" that compare to another item, or "melted" before butter.

modes.label: Start of a rare name
modes.description: A first piece of an unusual herb or drug name.
modes.example: aconite wu tou (<<ch>>uan wu) Other herbs
